data.one_liner: A customizable and editable data table and spreadsheet widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides an editable data table widget allowing users to modify cell contents, add empty rows, adjust column widths, and save edited rows either through built-in buttons or via a GlobalKey state.
use_when: You need an interactive spreadsheet-like grid where users can edit cell data directly.
You want to build custom data entry tables with customizable headers and zebra striping.
avoid_when: You only need to display read-only tabular data (use standard DataTable).
You require advanced spreadsheet calculation engines or formulas.
strengths: Supports inline editing of cell data and adding new rows dynamically.
Offers extensive styling options for borders, padding, headers, and zebra striping.
Compatible across Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Limited documentation regarding complex validation or custom cell editors beyond text inputs.
Depends on standard text inputs without advanced cell type definitions out-of-the-box.
data.minimal_example:
Editable(
  columns: cols,
  rows: rows,
  zebraStripe: true,
  stripeColor2: Colors.grey[200],
  borderColor: Colors.blueGrey,
)
